name: my-harness
description: Personal project-delivery harness skills for initializing projects and coordinating gstack, Superpowers, Pencil, browser checks, Git, release closeout, deployment governance documents, optional canary monitoring, and cross-platform plugin updates.

interface.longDescription: My Harness groups personal workflow skills for initializing project governance, deciding the next project action, creating design governance, writing DEPLOY.md deployment governance, running optional post-deploy canary monitoring, updating the harness plugin, and extending a gstack + Superpowers + Pencil + Playwright + Git delivery loop.
defaultPrompt: 我现在项目推进到哪一步了，下一步该做什么？
为当前空白项目初始化 README.md、AGENTS.md 和第一步 harness handoff
为这个项目初始化设计规范和 Pencil 原型目录
检查 my-harness 是否有新版本，并说明当前版本到目标版本的迭代
为当前项目生成 DEPLOY.md 部署治理文档，并链接到 AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md
对当前项目线上地址做一次 quick canary，只登记 GitHub issues，不修复问题
